title: Create and Destroy
prompt: Implement `DArray* da_create(int cap)` returning a heap-allocated DArray whose data is a heap array of cap ints (size 0), or NULL for cap <= 0 or allocation failure. Implement `void da_destroy(DArray *a)` freeing data and the struct itself (NULL-safe).

tests.name: usable
tests.hint: Two allocations: the struct and its buffer.
